scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple unicyclic graphs only; all edge generators have unit half-length and all coordinate generators share a positive real half-length t.
Euclidean distances are measured in the canonical orthonormal vertex-coordinate realization; arbitrary affine maps do not preserve the formulas.
The proof covers real t>0. The t=0 contact count differs and is not part of the claim.
Originality remains provisional because an equivalent older orientation-imbalance result may be unindexed.
title: A parity-and-minimum-cycle-degree law for enclosing spheres of unicyclic in-in zonotopes
